exposure: Having undergone spinal anesthesia for a cesarean section
outcome: Perceptions of the advantages of spinal anesthesia
cohort: The study included 150 pregnant women undergoing spinal anesthesia after cesarean sections.
finding: The study found that pregnant women had very low general knowledge about spinal anesthesia prior to surgery, but their post-operative perception of its advantages was entirely positive, with a negative correlation between perceived benefits and general information.
cross-section timing: Between April 23, 2024, and January 5, 2025, after cesarean sections.
